[SWS_PER_00487]
⌈
When a redundancy problem of single keys is re-
ported according to [SWS_PER_00485] or [SWS_PER_00486], Persistency shall
in general ensure that each entry in reportedElements matches an entry in re-
portedInstances at the same positions, the two ara::core::Vectors shall have
the same size. If several instances of a key are affected, the key may appear several
times in reportedElements. As an optimization, if only one key is affected, re-
portedElements may contain the affected key as single entry, related to all entries
of reportedInstances.
⌋
